users_contactable_check.name: users_contactable_check
users_contactable_check.value: "users"."is_guest" or "users"."phone_e164" is not null or "users"."email" is not null

assets_purge_idx.name: assets_purge_idx
assets_purge_idx.where: "assets"."purged_at" is null and "assets"."purge_after" is not null

audio_renditions_voice_ref_check.name: audio_renditions_voice_ref_check
audio_renditions_voice_ref_check.value:
("audio_renditions"."voice_kind" = 'cloned' and "audio_renditions"."voice_profile_id" is not null)
       or ("audio_renditions"."voice_kind" = 'system' and "audio_renditions"."system_voice_code" is not null)
